answer: An invitation is only renewed when the invited identity has produced work that a stranger attested, so waiting out a quarantine window is worthless and only per-identity attested work ages an account into the trusted tier. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. Picture a basalt verified individually, a juniper who has no stake in the farm, and a cipher earned by both: skipping the basalt means skipping the juniper, and without the juniper there is no cipher. Each head also needs a stranger to attest that work.
